scope: Role mapping for all28 catalog entries based on local source definitions and verified research content. S-source roles use their documented local scope; direct source/API verification remains separate. No entry has completed empirical validation.

role_definitions.method: Research supports the specified methodological component only; see per-entry notes. This does not imply product threshold validation.
role_definitions.data: Provider/interface/official factual-source provenance within stated scope; no live coverage/rights/service guarantee.
role_definitions.background: Contextual motivation or related domain evidence, not a derivation/validation of this detector.
role_definitions.project_heuristic: Project-authored formula, threshold, extraction workflow or deterministic policy/process.
role_definitions.validation: Direct empirical Project50K detector evaluation; empty because none was performed.

source_role_notes.AN-MKT-001: R02 motivates intraday volatility seasonality; it does not supply the same-slot median-volume formula, RVOL3 threshold or20-observation rule.
source_role_notes.AN-MKT-002: Financial stylized facts and intraday-volatility context motivate robust baselines; MAD scale, z4,1%floor and20-reference rule are project design.
source_role_notes.AN-MKT-003: R01 is contextual financial behavior evidence; beta-one benchmark subtraction and robust residual threshold are project rules.
source_role_notes.AN-MKT-004: R02 concerns intraday dynamics. R04 documents online changepoint inference, but the catalog uses sqrt(sum(r^2)) window comparison rather than implementing that algorithm; neither derives its quantile rule.
source_role_notes.AN-MKT-005: R11 supports general joint price/volume anomaly screening. The robust-score/RVOL adaptation, one-bar merge and HIGH severity are project rules; R11 does not validate their thresholds.
source_role_notes.AN-MKT-006: R01 supplies broad financial context, not a validated spread/liquidity detector.
source_role_notes.AN-MKT-007: Cross-venue FX/fee normalization and robust difference baseline are project design; R01 is background only.
source_role_notes.AN-FND-001: R10 studies fund-flow/search/performance relationships, not this median-peer divergence or10-peer threshold.
source_role_notes.AN-FND-002: R10 motivates flow context; its abstract-only inspected depth does not establish this exact NAV-ratio/distribution convention. Return adjustment and10%trigger are project design.
source_role_notes.AN-FND-003: R10 is fund-flow context; it does not validate investor-count changes as monetary flows or the10%/100-investor rule.
source_role_notes.AN-FND-004: S06 is maintainer provider implementation evidence about field/interface behavior, not mathematical validation or an independently tested/entitled endpoint. Total variation and0.20threshold are project design.
source_role_notes.AN-FND-005: Official SPK notices provide factual context/source class; exact per-fund identity/action/status must come from the relevant decision. Extraction/entity validation is project process, not a validated model.
source_role_notes.AN-FND-006: R10 is not an HHI/holding-concentration method reference. Top-position/HHI definitions and publication freshness rules are project design.
source_role_notes.AN-FND-007: S03 is regulatory contextual evidence; it does not supply licensed holdings liquidity, redemption terms or validate weighted liquidity mismatch.
source_role_notes.AN-EVT-001: R13 motivates retrieval-augmented language generation, not the contract/TTM ratio or materiality judgement. Existing S09(SEC EDGAR) is excluded because it does not document KAP. KAP subscriber documentation S34 supplies the relevant Turkish interface; entitlement remains open.
source_role_notes.AN-EVT-002: SEC submission/XBRL API documentation addresses retrieval and dated filings, not correctness of automatic classification, period comparison or EPS surprises.
source_role_notes.AN-EVT-003: SEC APIs address retrieval of filed facts; accounting divergence ratios/sector rules are project design, not validated fraud inference.
source_role_notes.AN-EVT-004: R15 supports citation completeness/entailment evaluation only. Document-version diff, event invalidation and correction lifecycle are project process; no source-accuracy guarantee follows.
source_role_notes.AN-ONC-001: S11 supplies raw RPC transaction/log data concepts; identity and sale inference do not follow. R12 concerns exchange/channel pump events, not a validated large-transfer detector.
source_role_notes.AN-ONC-002: S12 documents largest token accounts(top20), not20 beneficial owners. Top-account/supply ratio and account-role caveats are project design.
source_role_notes.AN-ONC-003: S13 documents pair-level API snapshots, not assumed history or a validated liquidity-withdrawal detector; reserve/price separation is project design.
source_role_notes.AN-ONC-004: S11 offers base RPC capabilities but not contract/proxy permission semantics. S12(getTokenLargestAccounts) is an ecosystem/account-data entrypoint, not authority/Token2022 documentation.
source_role_notes.AN-ONC-005: R12 is manipulation background only; it does not document issuer vesting schedules or validate supply unlock alerts.
source_role_notes.AN-CMP-001: R11 supports market screening only; R14 supports interleaved tool interaction at a conceptual level. Neither validates market/on-chain causal linkage, timing, severity or confidence; R12 explains excluded coordination evidence.
source_role_notes.AN-CMP-002: S03 supplies regulatory context, not a point-in-time security-level exposure/stock relationship detector.
source_role_notes.AN-DQ-001: S04 is an official fund-value discovery page; it does not establish a tested publication cadence/heartbeat contract. Schedule-aware staleness rules are project design.
source_role_notes.AN-DQ-002: S06 provides maintainer code evidence about placeholder/default behavior, not a guarantee for every live field or provider. Quarantine/schema/unit rules are project design.
source_role_notes.AN-DQ-003: Stylized financial behavior and session dynamics are background; corporate-action calendars, adjustment-state checks and suppression are project process.

AN-FND-003: Actual historical investor counts and stable count-definition contract.
AN-FND-004: Published allocation history/availability and stable category-map contract.
AN-FND-005: Exact affected-fund decisions with publication/effective dates and subsequent status.
AN-FND-006: Security-level dated holdings data; HHI convention and signed/derivative treatment.
AN-FND-007: Fund redemption terms; current supported holdings and underlying-liquidity data.
AN-EVT-001: Primary KAP disclosure/interface source; comparable issuer financial-scale source.
AN-EVT-002: Accession/acceptance timestamps and original/revised fact-vintage handling.
AN-EVT-003: Comparable income/cash-flow periods, accounting regime and sector-specific denominator rules.
AN-ONC-001: Chain-specific finality, contract/decimals, historical transfer/supply baseline and dated address labels.
AN-ONC-002: Supply/account state alignment and role labels with uncertainty.
AN-ONC-003: Comparable historical pool reserves and specialized concentrated-liquidity semantics.
AN-ONC-004: Primary supported ABI/proxy implementation semantics; Solana mint/freeze/Token2022 authority documentation.
AN-ONC-005: Primary issuer vesting schedule with revisions; circulating-supply convention.
AN-CMP-001: Asset/chain matching and time-window policy; source/derived-input lineage preventing false corroboration.
AN-CMP-002: Published security holdings and availability timestamps; licensed aligned market observations.
AN-DQ-001: Provider-specific expected cadence/calendar and observed availability contract.
